_meta.title: v6p5 cuda-priority throughput profile
_meta.summary: Use v6p5_cuda_pref for higher CUDA-side workload while keeping CNN-DDQN+DQfD method family.

self_check: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p5_cuda_pref --self-check
conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p5_cuda_pref --self-check

smoke.train: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p5_cuda_pref --device cuda --episodes 300 --out v6p5_cuda_pref_smoke300
smoke.infer: conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p5_cuda_pref --device cuda --models v6p5_cuda_pref_smoke300 --runs 3 --out v6p5_cuda_pref_smoke300

full.train: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p5_cuda_pref --device cuda --out v6p5_cuda_pref_full3000
full.infer: conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p5_cuda_pref --device cuda --models v6p5_cuda_pref_full3000 --runs 20 --out v6p5_cuda_pref_full3000

key_hparams.note: GPU throughput oriented; report separately from baseline v6p5 metrics
